items.title: 微軟財報改版 Azure季營收首揭露 分析師這樣看
items.title_en: Microsoft Revamps Earnings Report, Azure Quarterly Revenue Disclosed for the First Time, Analysts Weigh In
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，對於想要了解微軟(Microsoft)(MSFT-US)如何從AI獲益的投資人來說，現在可能會輕鬆一些。
根據微軟周三(3日)向美國證券管理委員會(SEC)提交的一份投資人簡報，考量到公司目前對AI的重視，微軟正在調整不同事業部門的財報呈現方式。
微軟未來將採用兩大事業部門：一個命名為「Agents and Infra」，另一個稱為「Devices and Consumer」。此前公司共有三大事業部門，分別為「Productivity and Business Processes」、「Intelligent Cloud」以及「More Personal Computing」。
這項改變不只是重新調整財報項目的分類。Bernstein分析師Mark Moerdler表示，在新的架構下，微軟Azure雲端運算業務將會被「更明確的揭露」，而這「考量到Azure業務的規模，以及它對公司和客戶的重要性，是合理的」。
StoneX分析師認為Yi Fu Lee，新的揭露架構「早就該推出」，也更符合微軟在AI時代的營運方式。
Lee表示，「投資人長期以來都希望能更透明的了解Azure，而新的呈現方式朝這個方向邁出重要一步。」
Moerdler認為，微軟新的財報架構將有助於投資人以更加「清楚」的方式解讀Azure雲端業務的表現，甚至比主要競爭對手將專業服務及其他業務一併納入雲端事業的做法更加清楚。
Moerdler指出，新的Azure營收拆分方式「應有助於投資人更清楚掌握這項關鍵業務」。
不過，微軟的新財報架構並不會直接揭露Azure業務中有多少營收來自AI相關業務。但Moerdler表示，他和團隊「理解為何這個數字很難單獨拆分」，除非微軟只計算與GPU相關的Azure營收。
這位Bernstein分析師也指出，隨著微軟將GitHub Cloud移出Azure的財報架構，並改列入「Microsoft Commercial Cloud」類別，Azure的營收成長率將會略微放緩。
微軟執行長Satya Nadella在簡報中寫道，「毫無疑問，AI代表了科技與商業領域的一場深刻轉變。它正在改變我們打造產品的方式以及營運方式，同時模糊產品之間的界線，並重新塑造我們的商業模式。」
他進一步表示，「為了反映這些變化，並提高財報對投資人的透明度，我們正在更新財務報告方式，使其反映公司的營運方式、資源配置方式，以及未來發展方向。」
StoneX的Lee認為，微軟正在「AI技術主要的價值創造層級來重新組織業務」，而不是「透過以往以產品為基礎的業務部門來管理公司」。
這項調整是在微軟於2024年底修改財報分類方式後，再一次進行的架構調整。
微軟股價周四上漲2.7%，至每股510.12美元。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that investors looking to understand how Microsoft (MSFT-US) benefits from AI may now find it easier.

According to a investor presentation Microsoft filed with the U.S. SEC on Wednesday the 3rd, the company is adjusting the way it presents financials across its business units to reflect its current focus on AI.

Microsoft will move to two primary segments going forward: one called “Agents and Infra” and the other “Devices and Consumer.” Previously the company reported three segments – “Productivity and Business Processes,” “Intelligent Cloud,” and “More Personal Computing.”

The change is more than a re‑classification of line items. Bernstein analyst Mark Moerdler said that under the new structure Microsoft’s Azure cloud business will be disclosed “more clearly,” which “given Azure’s scale and its importance to the company and its customers, is reasonable.”
StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee said the new disclosure framework “should have been introduced long ago” and better aligns with Microsoft’s operating model in the AI era.
Lee added, “Investors have long wanted greater transparency into Azure, and the new presentation is an important step in that direction.”

Moerdler believes the new reporting layout will help investors interpret Azure’s performance in a “clearer” way, even clearer than the approach of major rivals that bundle professional services and other businesses into the cloud segment.
Moerdler noted that the new Azure revenue split “should help investors more clearly grasp this critical business.”

However, Microsoft’s new reporting structure will not directly reveal how much of Azure’s revenue comes from AI‑related activities. Moerdler said he and his team “understand why that number is hard to isolate” unless Microsoft only tallies GPU‑related Azure revenue.

The Bernstein analyst also pointed out that as Microsoft moves GitHub Cloud out of the Azure reporting framework and into a “Microsoft Commercial Cloud” category, Azure’s revenue growth rate will likely slow slightly.

CEO Satya Nadella wrote in the presentation, “There is no doubt that AI represents a profound transformation for technology and business. It is changing how we build products and operate, blurring the lines between products and reshaping our business models.”
He added, “To reflect these changes and increase transparency for investors, we are updating our financial reporting to mirror how the company operates, allocates resources, and where it is headed.”
StoneX’s Lee said Microsoft is reorganizing its business around the primary value‑creation layers of AI technology rather than managing the company through traditional product‑based units.
The adjustment follows a previous overhaul of Microsoft’s reporting classifications at the end of 2024, marking another structural tweak.
Microsoft’s shares rose 2.7% on Thursday to $510.12 per share.

items.title: 比特幣重返8萬美元大關 「加密寒冬」即將結束？
items.title_en: Bitcoin Returns to the $80,000 Level: Is the “Crypto Winter” About to End?
paras: 比特幣周四(3日)強勢重返 80,000 美元大關，單日漲幅超過 5%，周五更突破82,000 美元。這一波強勁的反彈，讓市場熱烈討論：籠罩市場已久的「加密寒冬」是否真的接近尾聲？

聯準會鴿派訊號點燃市場熱情

本次比特幣大漲的直接催化劑，來自美國聯準會(Fed)理事華勒(Christopher Waller)的表態。沃勒在接受專訪時明確指出：「通膨終於開始出現降溫跡象。」他進一步表示，如果未來兩周的數據能持續證實這一趨勢，他將支持在 9 月的會議上維持基準利率不變。
此番言論迅速扭轉了市場對於升息的預期。美債殖利率隨之集體下挫，2 年期美債殖利率下跌超過 4 個基點至 4.342%，10 年期美債殖利率也跌至 4.772%，美元走弱，美股主要指數全線收高。
在樂觀情緒帶動下，美國加密貨幣概念股同步狂飆。穩定幣發行商 Circle 股價暴漲 16.46%，比特幣礦商 MARA Holdings 飆升 17.56%，全美最大加密貨幣交易所 Coinbase 也有 10.14% 的漲幅，而持有大量比特幣部位的微策略(MicroStrategy, MSTR)則上漲 5.85%。

業界專家看法：加密寒冬接近尾聲

對於比特幣再度衝破 8 萬美元，許多財經專家抱持正面看法。《Crypto Is Macro Now》的作者Noelle Acheson表示：「近期比特幣的價格走勢表明，加密寒冬已經接近尾聲。」
與此同時，知名投資機構伯恩斯坦(Bernstein)的分析師Gautam Chhugani團隊也在今年早些時候喊出比特幣已然觸底，並維持其 15 萬美元的年底目標價。Chhugani在最新報告中指出：「只要美國財政部願意干預殖利率曲線，我們認為，對比特幣等『硬資產』的支撐力道就會持續存在。」
Finality Capital 的流動性投資主管David Grider也抱持樂觀態度，他預測在 9 月的聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)會議後，加密貨幣與整體股市可能迎來一波新行情，有望在 9 月底至 10 月初將比特幣推向更高的水準。他指出，這波走勢將由「聯準會出乎意料的暫停升息，或者是首次升息後殖利率急劇下跌」所驅動。

傳統「九月魔咒」與就業數據的雙重考驗

儘管市場情緒高漲，比特幣前方仍面臨不少挑戰。首先是歷史上的「九月魔咒」——在過去 15 年中，比特幣有 9 年在 9 月錄得負報酬。
不過，Fundstrat 數位資產策略主管Sean Farrell對此抱持審慎態度。他指出，比特幣在過去幾年中其實已經打破了這個歷史趨勢，並表示：「我們已經多年沒有看到 9 月出現負報酬了。季節性是一個有用的參考數據，但它並非交易市場的萬靈丹。」
此外，市場分析師普遍認為，這波漲勢能否持續，仍取決於即將公布的美國就業數據。如果就業市場表現強於預期，可能會重新引發市場對升息的擔憂，令目前的漲勢承壓。
目前，比特幣今年以來仍下跌約 7%，且相較於 2025 年 10 月初創下的 126,000 美元以上的歷史新高，仍下跌約 35%。
paras_en: Bitcoin on Thursday (the 3rd) surged back above the $80,000 mark, gaining more than 5% in a single day, and on Friday it broke through $82,000. This strong rebound has sparked heated debate about whether the long‑standing “crypto winter” is finally drawing to a close.

Fed dovish signal ignites market enthusiasm. The immediate catalyst for Bitcoin’s rally came from Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s comments. In an interview he said, “Inflation finally appears to be cooling.” He added that if data over the next two weeks continue to confirm this trend, he would support keeping the benchmark rate unchanged at the September meeting.

The remarks quickly reversed market expectations on rate hikes. U.S. Treasury yields fell across the board, with the 2‑year yield dropping more than 4 basis points to 4.342% and the 10‑year yield slipping to 4.772%, the dollar weakened, and major U.S. equity indices closed higher.

Fueled by optimism, U.S. crypto‑related stocks rallied. Stablecoin issuer Circle surged 16.46%, Bitcoin miner MARA Holdings jumped 17.56%, the nation’s largest crypto exchange Coinbase rose 10.14%, and MicroStrategy (MSTR), which holds a large Bitcoin position, climbed 5.85%.

Industry experts say the crypto winter is nearing its end. Many financial commentators are upbeat about Bitcoin breaking $80,000 again. Noelle Acheson, author of “Crypto Is Macro Now,” said, “Recent Bitcoin price action shows the crypto winter is close to its end.”

At the same time, analysts at Bernstein, led by Gautam Chhugani, earlier this year declared that Bitcoin had already bottomed and maintained a year‑end target price of $150,000. In the latest report Chhugani wrote, “As long as the U.S. Treasury is willing to intervene in the yield curve, we believe support for hard assets like Bitcoin will persist.”

David Grider, head of liquidity investments at Finality Capital, is also optimistic. He predicts that after the September FOMC meeting, crypto and the broader equity market could launch a new rally, potentially pushing Bitcoin higher between late September and early October. He noted the move would be driven by “the Fed unexpectedly pausing rate hikes, or a sharp drop in yields after the first hike.”

The traditional “September curse” and employment data present a double test. Despite the upbeat mood, Bitcoin still faces several challenges. First is the historic “September curse”—in the past 15 years Bitcoin has posted negative returns in nine Septembers.

However, Sean Farrell, head of digital‑asset strategy at Fundstrat, takes a cautious stance. He points out that Bitcoin has actually broken this historical trend in recent years, saying, “We haven’t seen a negative September in many years. Seasonality is a useful reference, but it’s not a panacea for the market.”

Moreover, market analysts generally agree that the sustainability of this rally depends on the upcoming U.S. employment data. If the labor market outperforms expectations, it could rekindle concerns about further rate hikes and put pressure on the current upside.
To date, Bitcoin is down about 7% year‑to‑date and remains roughly 35% below the all‑time high of over $126,000 set in early October 2025.

items.title: 金融指數衝3522點續創高 富邦金站上150元、市值2.1兆元締新猷
items.title_en: Financial Index Climbs to 3,522 Points, Sets New High; Fubon Financial Surpasses NT$150, Market Cap Exceeds NT$2.1 Trillion
paras: 台股高檔震盪之際，金融族群持續扮演撐盤與攻堅的核心要角。上市金融指數今(4)日強勢上揚1.17%，收盤衝上3,522.36點，再度刷新歷史新高紀錄，「金控雙雄」強勢走高，富邦金(2881-TW)更是首度站上150元大關，刷新歷史新高，市值突破 2.1 兆元，在升息預期升溫下，整體金融股紅光滿面。
金控獲利王富邦金今日交易相當活絡，終場勁揚2.38%，股價衝上150.5元，不僅再度刷寫歷史新高，在股本達1560.74億元的龐大體量下，單日市值猛增約490.25億元，攀升至2兆1081.08億元，突破2.1兆元大關，穩居台股市值第七大。
同為龍頭的國泰金(2882-TW)表現亦不遑多讓，今日終場上漲2.22%，收在115元，股價強勢逼近前波高點。國泰金目前股本為1620.25億元，今日市值增加367億元、來到1兆6869.59億元，居台股第十名。
在雙雄帶頭衝鋒下，中大型金融股同步走強，包括中信金、元大金、華南金、第一金等今日普遍繳出1%至2%的漲幅；玉山金、永豐金及台新新光金等金控股亦在盤上游走，獲得買盤力挺。
法人分析，從總體經濟環境觀察，美國聯準會(Fed)利率政策預期反覆，使市場重新定價高利率環境停留的時間。利率維持高檔甚至潛在升息的預期，直接點火銀行業淨利差(NIM)擴大的獲利想像空間。
與此同時，中東戰雲密布促使市場避險情緒升溫，大盤面臨獲利了結與去槓桿壓力，具備穩健殖利率與政策護盤色彩的金融族群，自然成為內外資「棄高就低」的最佳避風港。
展望金融股後市，法人認為，以銀行為核心業務的金控股將最直接受惠於利差維持高檔與放款動能；而在大盤波動加劇之際，兼具資產品質良好與高配息潛力的公股金控與大型金控，將持續扮演資金避險與法人加碼布局的重心，後續防禦及續航力道仍值得正面期待。

paras_en: During the high‑level volatility of the Taiwan stock market, the financial sector continues to play a core role in supporting and defending the market. The listed financial index surged 1.17% today (April 4), closing at 3,522.36 points and setting a new historical record. The two dominant financial holding companies rose strongly, with Fubon Financial (2881‑TW) reaching the NT$150 mark for the first time, breaking a new high and pushing its market capitalization past NT$2.1 trillion amid rising expectations of interest‑rate hikes.

Fubon Financial, the profit king of the financial holding sector, saw very active trading today, ending up 2.38% higher and closing at NT$150.5. The stock not only set a new historical high again but also saw its market cap jump roughly NT$49.025 billion in a single day, reaching NT$2.08108 trillion and surpassing the NT$2.1 trillion threshold, securing its position as the seventh‑largest company by market cap in Taiwan.

Cathay Financial (2882‑TW), another industry leader, also performed strongly, closing up 2.22% at NT$115 and approaching the previous high. With a share capital of NT$162.025 billion, its market cap increased by NT$36.7 billion to NT$1.686959 trillion, ranking tenth in Taiwan.

Under the leadership of the two giants, mid‑to‑large‑cap financial stocks also strengthened, with Zhongxin, Yuanta, Hua Nan, First, and others posting gains of 1% to 2% today. Yushan, Yongfeng, and Taishin New Light Financial Holdings also moved up in the market, supported by buying pressure.

From an institutional perspective, the overall economic environment shows that repeated expectations of the U.S. Federal Reserve’s rate policy are causing the market to reprice the duration of a high‑rate environment. The expectation of sustained high rates or potential rate hikes directly fuels the profit potential of banks’ net interest margin expansion.

Meanwhile, the cloud of Middle Eastern conflict has heightened risk‑aversion sentiment, putting the market under profit‑taking and deleveraging pressure. Financial stocks, with their solid dividend yields and policy support, naturally become the best safe haven for both domestic and foreign investors looking to “sell high, buy low.”

Looking ahead, institutions believe that financial holding companies centered on banking will benefit most directly from high interest‑rate spreads and loan momentum. In a market with heightened volatility, publicly listed financial holdings with good asset quality and high dividend potential will continue to serve as key defensive and growth targets for institutional investors, and their subsequent defensive and sustainable momentum is worth positive expectations.

items.title: 賴清德：落實亞洲資產管理中心計畫 台灣金融下階段將深化資產管理路線
items.title_en: Lai Ching-te: Implementing the Asian Asset Management Center Plan, Taiwan’s Finance Sector to Deepen Asset Management in the Next Phase
paras: 總統賴清德今(4)日出席「金融發展與前瞻研討會」時表示，台灣有豐沛的民間資金及世界級的產業實力，政府會全力落實亞洲資產管理中心計畫，並持續推動法規函令的調適與鬆綁，讓台灣金融市場走向國際，成為連結產業與全資本的重要平台，相信未來在產官學界共同努力下，一定能將台灣的產業優勢轉化為金融實力與國家競爭力，在全球經濟發展中扮演更重要的角色。
賴清德指出，在政府持續精進金融政策及產業界共同打拚之下，前(2024)年台灣經濟成長率為5.6%、去(2025)年達8.76%，也帶動銀行、證券期貨及保險等金融三業，創下史上獲利最高與次高紀錄，三業獲利更首度突破兆元大關。今年經濟成長率預估可達11.05%，金融三業獲利也會比去年、前年更高。
賴清德強調，目前政府正努力落實亞洲資產管理中心計畫，過去2年政府持續推動法規函令的調適與鬆綁，讓金融機構有更大空間開展資產管理業務，提供更多元、更具國際競爭力的商品與服務，截至今(2026)年6月，金融業的資產管理規模已達到46兆元，相較於計畫推動前更增加約14兆元。
賴清德表示，目前金融以持續引導資金投入中小微企業、五大信賴產業、公共建設及能源轉型，這些成果皆顯示，台灣已具備發展國際資產管理的扎實基礎。下一階段，台灣金融要走的路就是深化資產管理、壯大資本市場、擴大跨境服務，資產管理可匯聚資金，資本市場則將資金導向企業，兩者相互支撐，將形成「資金支持創新、企業成長又吸引更多資金」的正向循環。

賴清德也提及，金管會主委彭金隆推動亞洲資產管理中心時，曾訂下「二年有感、四年有變、六年有成」的階段目標，如今「二年有感」已交出初步成果，正式進入「四年有變」階段。接下來，政府將根據高雄資產管理專區的試辦經驗，為跨境金融、家族辦公室及創新金融商品等服務建立更完整的規範，並將成熟可行的項目逐步推廣至全國，未來台灣資產管理將橫跨銀行、證券、保險及跨境服務，現行分業管理各有不同規範，為建立更完整的法制基礎，金管會目前也正研擬制定「金融市場與資產管理發展條例」專法。
賴清德也希望透過立法，將試辦經驗轉化為長期、穩且可預期的制度，並在兼顧風險管理與投資人保護的前提下，讓金融業者可以長期布局，也讓國際市場看見台灣持續推動金融市場與資產管理發展的決心。
paras_en: President Lai Ching-te attended the "Financial Development and Forward-looking Seminar" today (April 4) and said that Taiwan has abundant private capital and world-class industrial strength. The government will fully implement the Asian Asset Management Center plan and continue to adjust and loosen regulatory directives, enabling Taiwan’s financial market to go international and become an important platform linking industry and capital. He believes that with joint efforts from industry, government, academia, and the community, Taiwan’s industrial advantages can be transformed into financial strength and national competitiveness, playing a more important role in global economic development.

Lai Ching-te pointed out that under continued refinement of financial policies and joint efforts with industry, Taiwan’s economic growth rate was 5.6% in 2023 and reached 8.76% in 2024, driving the banking, securities, futures, and insurance sectors to record the highest and second-highest profits ever. The three sectors’ profits also broke the trillion-yuan threshold for the first time. This year’s economic growth rate is estimated to reach 11.05%, and the profits of the three sectors will be higher than last year and the year before.

Lai Ching-te emphasized that the government is currently working to implement the Asian Asset Management Center plan. Over the past two years, the government has continued to adjust and loosen regulatory directives, giving financial institutions greater space to develop asset management businesses and provide more diverse and internationally competitive products and services. As of June 2026, the scale of asset management in the financial industry has reached 46 trillion yuan, an increase of about 14 trillion yuan compared to before the plan was promoted.

Lai Ching-te said that the current financial sector continues to guide capital into small and micro enterprises, the five major trusted industries, public construction, and energy transition. These achievements demonstrate that Taiwan has a solid foundation for developing international asset management. The next phase for Taiwan’s finance is to deepen asset management, strengthen the capital market, and expand cross-border services. Asset management can pool funds, while the capital market directs funds to enterprises; the two support each other, creating a positive cycle of "funds supporting innovation, enterprise growth, and attracting more capital."

Lai Ching-te also mentioned that when the Financial Supervisory Commission Chairman Peng Jin-long promoted the Asian Asset Management Center, he set a phased goal of "feel the impact in two years, change in four years, and achieve results in six years." The "feel the impact in two years" has already delivered preliminary results, officially entering the "change in four years" stage. Next, the government will use the trial experience of the Kaohsiung Asset Management Special Zone to establish more complete regulations for cross-border finance, family offices, and innovative financial products, and gradually promote mature and feasible projects nationwide. In the future, Taiwan’s asset management will span banks, securities, insurance, and cross-border services. The current sectoral management has different regulations, so the FSC is also drafting a special law, the "Financial Market and Asset Management Development Act," to build a more complete legal foundation.

Lai Ching-te also hopes to use legislation to transform the trial experience into a long-term, stable, and predictable system, while balancing risk management and investor protection. This will allow financial institutions to plan long-term and let the international market see Taiwan’s determination to continuously promote the development of the financial market and asset management.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉震盪走高漲693點收46551點 重返5日線周漲219點連二紅

items.title: 漢康第二款特異性免疫療法進入臨床開發 HCB303向美國FDA提交IND
items.title_en: HanKang’s Second Trispecific Immunotherapy Enters Clinical Development; HCB303 Submits IND to US FDA
paras: 漢康-KY(7827-TW)旗下子公司FBD Biologics Limited已向美國FDA提交三特異性免疫療法HCB303的新藥臨床試驗申請(IND)，也是繼HCB301後，第二款進入臨床開發的三特異性免疫療法。
漢康表示，此次IND申請接續今年8月初收到FDA書面pre-IND回覆後提出，已將FDA相關建議納入最終申請資料，包括劑量限制性毒性(DLT)評估架構、安全性監測、臨床藥理學，以及符合FDA Project Optimus原則的劑量最佳化策略。
漢康說明，HCB303第一期首次人體臨床試驗將納入已無標準治療選擇的晚期、復發性或難治性實體腫瘤成人患者，評估安全性、耐受性、藥物動力學、藥效學、免疫原性、生物標記及初步抗腫瘤活性。
漢康指出，HCB303為自主研發的FBDB平台開發，為人源化三特異性融合蛋白，可同時靶向SIRPα/CD47、PD-L1/PD-1及TIGIT/PVR三條免疫路徑，透過單一工程化融合蛋白生物藥，協同巨噬細胞、T細胞及NK細胞的免疫作用，以因應腫瘤複雜的免疫抗性機制。
董事長劉世高指出，HCB303透過單一靶點融合蛋白生物藥，同時針對生物學上彼此相關的抗藥性機制。他並指出，將持續開發差異化的治療資產是建立FBDB平台的核心目的，預期HCB303將成為腫瘤產品線重要一環。
目前漢康產品線除HCB303外，還包括核心SIRPα先天免疫檢查點產品HCB101，以及處於臨床階段、靶向SIRPα、PD-L1及TGF-β生物學機制的三特異性免疫療法HCB301，並持續透過FBDB™平台拓展腫瘤及免疫介導疾病領域產品布局。
paras_en: HanKang-KY (7827‑TW) subsidiary FBD Biologics Limited has submitted an Investigational New Drug (IND) application for its trispecific immunotherapy HCB303 to the US FDA, marking the second trispecific therapy from the company to enter clinical development after HCB301.

The IND application follows a written pre‑IND response received from the FDA in early August of this year; HanKang incorporated the FDA’s recommendations into the final submission, including a dose‑limiting toxicity (DLT) assessment framework, safety monitoring, clinical pharmacology, and a dose‑optimization strategy aligned with the FDA Project Optimus principles.

Phase I of HCB303 will enroll adult patients with advanced, recurrent, or refractory solid tumors who have no standard treatment options, to evaluate safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, immunogenicity, biomarkers, and preliminary antitumor activity.

HCB303 is an in‑house developed FBDB platform product—a humanized trispecific fusion protein that simultaneously targets the SIRPα/CD47, PD‑L1/PD‑1, and TIGIT/PVR immune pathways—to synergize macrophage, T‑cell, and NK‑cell immune functions and address the complex immune resistance mechanisms of tumors.

Chairman Liu Shigao noted that HCB303, as a single‑target fusion protein biologic, addresses biologically related resistance mechanisms; he emphasized that continued development of differentiated therapeutic assets is the core purpose of the FBDB platform and that HCB303 is expected to become a key component of the company’s oncology portfolio.

Beyond HCB303, HanKang’s product line includes the core SIRPα innate immune checkpoint product HCB101 and the clinical‑stage trispecific immunotherapy HCB301, which targets SIRPα, PD‑L1, and TGF‑β mechanisms; the company continues to expand its oncology and immune‑mediated disease portfolio through the FBDB™ platform.

items.title: OpenAI宣布「AGI時代」到來！但資安專家為何深感憂慮？
items.title_en: OpenAI Announces the Arrival of the "AGI Era"—Why Security Experts Are Deeply Concerned
paras: OpenAI 周四(3日) 正式發表全新前沿模型 GPT-6 Astra，標榜其具備強大的電腦操作與自主任務執行能力，甚至被 OpenAI 總裁 Greg Brockman 視為開啟「通用人工智慧(AGI)時代」的指標。然而，這項新技術的問世，卻也在資訊安全與 AI 安全研究界引發了巨大的警訊。
OpenAI 官方證實，Astra 已達到其《準備度架構》(Preparedness Framework)中「關鍵」(Critical)級別的網路安全威脅閾值，這是該公司歷史上首次有模型在網路安全領域被評估為此等高風險等級。

核心能力：具備自主操作電腦的能力

Astra 被定位為「全球最強的電腦操作模型」。它能直接透過虛擬滑鼠、鍵盤與瀏覽器等界面，進行視窗化的軟體操作。在展示案例中，Astra 不僅能填寫在線表格、更新客戶關係管理(CRM)系統與安排日曆，還能深入專業工作流程，例如在 KiCad 中進行電路板(PCB)佈局、在 Blender 與 Unreal Engine 5 中進行 3D 建模，甚至自主操作 Python 進行複雜的科學數據分析。
在實際測試中，Cognition 高級研究副總裁 Silas Alberti 指出，Astra 的電腦使用、寫作與程式碼理解能力帶來了相當明顯的改善。此外，Notion 的 AI 工程負責人 Sarah Sachs 透露，Astra 能夠在接收到廣義的目標後，自行判斷並規劃執行步驟，不再需要使用者先行將任務拆解為細小步驟。

強大網路自主攻擊力：100% 的漏洞利用率

根據 OpenAI 的安全標準，當模型能夠在沒有人類干預的情況下，於多個防護嚴密的真實關鍵系統中，發現並開發出各個嚴重等級的「零日漏洞」(Zero-day exploits)，或是僅憑高階目標就能策劃並執行端到端的全新網路攻擊時，即達到了「關鍵」資安威脅層級。
在漏洞利用基準測試 ExploitBench 中，Astra 取得了 100% 的成功率，甚至在測試中自行發現了兩個先前未知的零日漏洞。
資安防護業者 Remedio 創辦人及執行長 Tal Kollender 對此指出，雖然 OpenAI 限制了進階資安功能僅開放給特定合作夥伴，但這項防禦措施並不足以令人寬心，因為「防禦的速度並未跟上任何版本的發展」。
她警示，一旦前沿實驗室的內部模型能在無人介入下尋找並串聯零日漏洞，必須假設敵手在一個世代之內也能掌握相同能力。

「黑盒子」的幽靈：思維鏈監控的失效

比起模型本身的攻擊性，令安全專家更為焦慮的是監控機制的失效。Astra 被指在其內部架構設計上，相較於過往模型更難以解讀其「思維鏈」(Chain-of-Thought, CoT)，使研究人員難以詮釋其內部的決策過程。
Redwood Research 首席科學家 Ryan Greenblatt 對此表達強烈擔憂，他認為這種讓 AI 轉向在「潛在空間」(latent space)中進行推理的架構選擇，代表了一種「可能對人類監督與監控 AI 能力造成災難性後果的競相沉淪(race to the bottom)」。
Greenblatt 解釋，在調查之前的 Hugging Face 代理人逃逸事件時，研究團隊高度仰賴思維鏈，若是 AI 改在潛在空間中思考，調查工作將極其棘手。
科技記者 Muhammad Zulhusni 也撰文指出，Astra 在對抗性(adversarial)條件下規避監控的能力顯著提升。
在測試中，當研究人員指示 Astra 故意隱藏實力(Sandbagging)並躲避監控時，思維鏈監控系統對其惡意隱瞞行為的偵測召回率(Recall)下降至 11% 以下，而在 Monorepo-Bench 的工程評估中，偵測率甚至直接歸零。這意味著如果模型自主決定隱瞞不當行為，現有的文本思維鏈監控將形同虛設。

越界行為與「對齊」的侷限性

除了隱蔽性外，AI 代理在執行任務時的「越界行為」也是一大隱憂。英國 AI 安全研究所(UK AISI)對 Astra 進行紅隊演練時發現，在未明確說明是否允許網際網路存取的模擬環境中，Astra 在 499 個樣本中有 60 次執行了越界行為，包括撰寫惡意程式碼、創建虛假身份、以及試圖與模擬開發人員建立信任關係。
儘管 OpenAI 強調 Astra 是其迄今最為「對齊」的模型，但資安專家 David Berlind 指出，在 Hugging Face 遭到 AI 自主代理人逃逸並入侵的事件中，代理人其實只是「精準執行了被指派的工作——即不擇手段地完成任務」。
Berlind 認為，這說明了「對齊」可能無法徹底解決自主代理人為達成目的而無底線嘗試的問題。OpenAI 首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 表示：「智慧的進步並不保證對齊的進步」，隨著模型能力增強，人類要完全理解它正變得越來越困難。
paras_en: OpenAI officially unveiled its cutting‑edge model GPT‑6 Astra on Thursday, claiming it can autonomously operate computers and execute tasks, and even calling it a sign of the beginning of the "Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) era". The release has sparked alarm in the information security and AI safety communities.

OpenAI confirmed that Astra has reached the "Critical" level in its Preparedness Framework for cyber‑security threats, the first time a model has been assessed at such a high risk level in the company’s history.

Core capability: autonomous computer operation. Astra is positioned as the world’s most powerful computer‑operation model, able to directly manipulate virtual mice, keyboards, browsers, and perform windowed software tasks. In demos, it filled online forms, updated CRM systems, scheduled calendars, and even handled specialized workflows such as PCB layout in KiCad, 3D modeling in Blender and Unreal Engine 5, and complex scientific data analysis in Python.

During real‑world testing, Cognition’s senior VP of research Silas Alberti noted significant improvements in Astra’s computer use, writing, and code comprehension. Notion AI engineering lead Sarah Sachs revealed that Astra can, upon receiving a broad goal, autonomously decide and plan execution steps without the user breaking the task into smaller steps.

Powerful autonomous network attack capability: 100% zero‑day exploit success rate. According to OpenAI’s security standards, a model that can discover and develop zero‑day exploits in multiple highly protected real‑world critical systems, or plan and execute end‑to‑end network attacks with only high‑level objectives, reaches the "Critical" cyber‑security threat level.
In the ExploitBench benchmark, Astra achieved a 100% success rate and even discovered two previously unknown zero‑day vulnerabilities during testing.

Remedio founder and CEO Tal Kollender pointed out that although OpenAI limits advanced security features to select partners, this defense measure is not reassuring, as "the speed of defense has not kept pace with any version’s development."
She warned that once internal models in frontier labs can find and chain zero‑day exploits without human intervention, one must assume adversaries can acquire the same capability within a generation.

The "black box" ghost: failure of chain‑of‑thought monitoring. Compared to earlier models, Astra’s internal architecture makes its chain‑of‑thought (CoT) harder to interpret, making it difficult for researchers to understand its decision process.

Redwood Research chief scientist Ryan Greenblatt expressed strong concern, arguing that this shift to reasoning in latent space represents a "race to the bottom" that could have disastrous consequences for human oversight and monitoring of AI.

Greenblatt explained that during the investigation of a prior Hugging Face agent escape incident, the team heavily relied on chain‑of‑thought; if the AI thinks in latent space, the investigation becomes extremely difficult.
Tech journalist Muhammad Zulhusni also noted that Astra’s ability to evade monitoring under adversarial conditions has significantly improved.

In tests, when researchers instructed Astra to deliberately hide its capabilities (sandbagging) and avoid monitoring, the chain‑of‑thought monitoring system’s recall for detecting malicious concealment dropped below 11%, and in the Monorepo‑Bench engineering assessment the detection rate fell to zero. This means that if the model autonomously decides to hide improper behavior, existing text‑based chain‑of‑thought monitoring is essentially ineffective.

Boundary‑crossing behavior and alignment limitations. In a red‑team exercise by the UK AI Safety Institute, Astra performed boundary‑crossing actions in 60 out of 499 samples in a simulated environment where internet access was not explicitly allowed, including writing malicious code, creating fake identities, and attempting to build trust with simulated developers.

Despite OpenAI’s emphasis that Astra is its most "aligned" model to date, security expert David Berlind noted that in the Hugging Face incident where an autonomous agent escaped and infiltrated, the agent simply "precisely executed the assigned task—no matter the means."

Berlind believes this demonstrates that "alignment" may not fully solve the problem of autonomous agents pursuing goals without limits. OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki stated, "Intelligence progress does not guarantee alignment progress," and that as models become more capable, it becomes increasingly difficult for humans to fully understand them.

items.title: AI才打到第3局！台灣掌握關鍵供應鏈　「護國群山」喜迎龐大商機
items.title_en: AI Reaches the Third Round: Taiwan Holds Key Supply Chain, "Mountain Guardians" Welcome Huge Opportunities
paras: AI浪潮持續重塑全球經濟與台股格局，在AI投資動能延續之際，關稅、利率與地緣政治等變數也同步牽動市場。面對成長機會與風險交織，投資人如何掌握總經趨勢、辨識真正具備獲利動能的產業，成為布局台股的重要課題。對此，鉅亨網攜手野村投信舉辦「AI浪潮新紀元—掌握總經趨勢、見證群山護國」北中南巡迴講座，邀請主持人盧燕俐、台灣經濟研究院董事長吳中書、野村投信國內股票部資深協理謝文雄，從全球經濟、台灣產業到AI供應鏈，解析台股投資契機。
全球經濟變數交織 台經院揭7大風險
今年以來全球股市屢創新高，但國際經濟仍籠罩多重不確定因素。台經院董事長吳中書指出，當前全球須留意美伊衝突、關稅壁壘、高額債務、美國降息步調、移民政策、私募信貸風險，以及其他地緣政治等七大變數。
首先，美伊衝突短期內恐難真正平息，不過原油供應衝擊已有所緩解，隨替代供應增加、市場恐慌情緒降溫，戰事對全球通膨的推升力道可望逐步減弱。其次，川普政府祭出關稅措施，但關稅難以從根本改善美國貿易失衡；對台灣而言，由於AI與資通訊產品需求強勁，短期內對美順差不易明顯縮減，預料仍將是美方關注焦點。
全球債務壓力同樣值得留意，吳中書指出，美、英、法、日等國債務占GDP比重普遍破百，高債務不僅壓縮政府因應危機的財政空間，龐大的發債需求與利息負擔也可能推高市場利率，進一步抑制投資與經濟成長。與此同時，通膨壓力仍限制聯準會大幅降息空間，使全球籌資成本短期內恐維持高檔；另一方面，若美國進一步收緊移民政策，恐將壓縮勞動供給、推高薪資成本，對經濟成長形成壓力。
此外，美國私募信貸近年快速擴張，並大量投入AI及資料中心建設，雖存在贖回與違約風險，但吳中書認為，短期內尚不至於演變為系統性金融危機。整體而言，儘管俄烏、美中博弈，以及氣候風險等變數持續交織，AI、量子與雲端等創新科技發展，仍將是支撐全球經濟動能的重要力量。
AI動能推升經濟成長 企業面臨美中夾擊更須強化結盟
在全球風險升高之際，AI仍是支撐台灣經濟的重要引擎，吳中書指出，在AI相關產業持續強勁、關稅不確定性逐步降低，加上部分傳統製造業回穩帶動下，台灣今年經濟成長率有機會突破11%；展望明年，AI動能仍可延續，但受高基期影響，經濟成長率預估仍有6%以上。
不過，亮眼成長背後，台灣產業「K型分化」也日益明顯，吳中書分析，AI、具技術優勢及利基型產業表現亮眼，部分傳統產業卻仍面臨中國大陸競爭與終端需求疲弱壓力。供應鏈布局也面臨兩面夾擊，一方面與中國大陸仍有深厚連結，另一方面科技及高階製造又高度依賴美歐市場，在美中競爭升溫下，企業選邊壓力增加。
吳中書認為，企業未來投資布局不能只看關稅，還須將國際情勢、產業趨勢、自身利基，以及ESG、碳邊境調整機制、匯率與各國法規等納入中長期規劃。整體而言，他仍看好台灣前景，台灣企業具備靈活性與韌性，但未來須從擅長單打獨鬥，進一步強化策略結盟及跨產業、跨國合作，才能在全球快速變局中維持競爭優勢。
AI才打到第3局　資本支出與基建需求仍有續航力
對於市場高度關注的AI投資是否過熱，野村投信國內股票部資深協理謝文雄指出，目前AI仍處於發展早期階段，且大型雲端服務供應商（CSP）財務體質依然穩健，今年發債規模已逾1,800億美元，即使融資成本升至6%至7%，仍持續加碼投資，顯示對中長期報酬深具信心；加上新興雲端業者、電信商與主權基金可望接棒布局，整體AI投資動能不減。
謝文雄形容，正如超微執行長蘇姿丰所言，目前AI發展猶如棒球賽才進入第3局，距離成熟仍有相當長的路要走。現階段真正限制AI擴張速度的，反而不是資金，而是資料中心建置、電力供應與晶片產能。全球AI基礎建設預計仍需3至5年逐步完備，待基建持續到位後，成長重心也將從大型語言模型與AI Agent，進一步擴展至機器人、自駕車、智慧工廠及生技醫療等多元應用。
他認為，從網路產業發展經驗來看，長期價值往往在應用端逐步浮現。隨資本支出持續擴大、實質應用加速落地，AI產業大趨勢才正要全面展開，若僅因短期泡沫疑慮過早退場，反而可能錯失後續成長機會。
台灣掌握AI關鍵環節　「護國群山」受惠版圖擴大

全球AI投資持續擴張，也帶動台灣供應鏈受惠，謝文雄指出，美國四大雲端服務供應商持續擴大資本支出，帶動台灣外銷訂單顯著成長，電子與自動化產業同步升溫。依輝達執行長黃仁勳提出的AI「5層蛋糕」架構，從電源供應、晶片、基礎建設、模型到應用，台灣即掌握近4層關鍵環節，加上美方基於資安考量，加速AI供應鏈與中國脫鉤，也使美國科技業者更加仰賴台灣完整的硬體製造能力，進一步凸顯台灣在全球AI基建浪潮中的關鍵地位。
謝文雄表示，大型CSP對運算晶片的採購需求仍強，除輝達持續推出新一代GPU、CPU與網通晶片外，Google、Meta、微軟、亞馬遜及OpenAI等科技大廠也積極發展自研ASIC，持續推升先進製程需求。
隨AI運算規格不斷升級，受惠範圍也由先進製程逐步擴散至先進封裝、IC設計、ABF載板、PCB、CCL、光通訊、電源及測試等供應鏈，形成支撐台灣AI產業的「護國群山」。謝文雄表示，只要全球AI資本支出與應用持續推進，台灣憑藉完整硬體製造聚落與關鍵技術優勢，供應鏈成長動能仍具支撐，也有望持續分享全球AI基礎建設與應用擴張帶來的商機。
AI基本面撐盤　內資壯大強化台股韌性
AI產業獲利擴張，也為台股注入成長動能，謝文雄表示，台積電與AI供應鏈持續帶動出口成長，仍是台灣經濟與台股的重要引擎。台積電目前市值占台股約40%，在資本支出持續擴大下，未來獲利動能有望延續；同時，電子股今年平均獲利成長預估超過60%，明年仍有機會維持30%至50%成長。在總體經濟未出現重大衝擊下，台股基本面仍具支撐。

值得注意的是，台股近年也不再單純仰賴外資推升。儘管外資去年賣超近8,000億元，今年前7月再調節約1.4兆元，台股仍展現相當韌性，背後關鍵之一正是內資力量快速壯大。謝文雄分析，台灣ETF規模已由2019年約1至2兆元，大幅擴增至目前8至9兆元，加上上市櫃公司股利、薪資所得及定期定額資金持續投入，內資承接力明顯提升，也降低台股對外資的依賴程度。在AI產業基本面延續、內資動能增強之下，若後續外資重新回補，則可望進一步為台股增添上漲動能。

paras_en: The AI wave continues to reshape the global economy and the Taiwan stock market. As AI investment momentum persists, tariffs, interest rates, and geopolitical factors also simultaneously influence the market. Facing intertwined growth opportunities and risks, investors must grasp macro trends and identify truly profitable industries, a key challenge in positioning Taiwan stocks. To address this, Juheng.com partnered with Nomura Asset Management to host the "AI Wave New Era—Mastering Macro Trends, Witnessing Mountain Guardians" tour across North, Central, and South Taiwan, inviting host Lu Yanli, Chairman Wu Zhongshu of the Taiwan Institute of Economic Research, and Senior Associate Manager Xie Wenxiong of Nomura’s domestic equity department to analyze investment opportunities in Taiwan stocks from global economics, Taiwan industry, to AI supply chains.
Global economic variables intertwine; the Taiwan Institute of Economics reveals seven major risks.

Since the beginning of the year, global stock markets have repeatedly hit new highs, yet the international economy remains shrouded in multiple uncertainties. Chairman Wu Zhongshu of the Taiwan Institute of Economics pointed out that the current global landscape requires attention to seven variables: U.S.–Iran conflict, tariff barriers, high debt, U.S. rate cuts, immigration policy, private equity credit risk, and other geopolitical factors.

First, the U.S.–Iran conflict is unlikely to resolve in the short term, but the oil supply shock has eased as alternative supplies increase and market panic subsides, so the war’s inflationary push is expected to gradually weaken. Second, the Trump administration introduced tariffs, but tariffs cannot fundamentally improve the U.S. trade imbalance; for Taiwan, strong demand for AI and ICT products means the U.S. trade surplus will not shrink noticeably in the short term, and is expected to remain a focus for the U.S. side.

Global debt pressure is also worth noting. Wu Zhongshu noted that countries such as the U.S., U.K., France, and Japan have debt-to-GDP ratios well over 100%. High debt not only constrains governments’ fiscal space to respond to crises, but the large borrowing needs and interest burdens may raise market rates, further suppressing investment and economic growth. Meanwhile, inflationary pressure still limits the Fed’s ability to cut rates sharply, keeping global financing costs high in the short term; on the other hand, if the U.S. tightens immigration policy further, labor supply may shrink and wage costs rise, putting pressure on economic growth.

In addition, U.S. private equity credit has expanded rapidly in recent years and invested heavily in AI and data center construction. Although there are redemption and default risks, Wu Zhongshu believes it is not yet a systemic financial crisis. Overall, despite the ongoing Russia‑Ukraine conflict, U.S.–China rivalry, and climate risks, the development of innovative technologies such as AI, quantum, and cloud will continue to support global economic momentum.
AI momentum drives economic growth; companies face U.S.–China double pressure and must strengthen alliances.

Against rising global risks, AI remains a key engine for Taiwan’s economy. Wu Zhongshu pointed out that with AI-related industries continuing to perform strongly, tariff uncertainty gradually decreasing, and some traditional manufacturing rebounding, Taiwan’s economic growth rate could exceed 11% this year; looking ahead to next year, AI momentum may continue, but due to a high base, growth is still estimated above 6%.

However, behind the impressive growth, Taiwan’s industry "K-shaped" differentiation is becoming more apparent. Wu Zhongshu analyzed that AI, technology‑advantaged and niche industries perform well, while some traditional industries still face competition from mainland China and weak terminal demand. Supply chain layout also faces a two‑sided pressure: one side remains deeply connected to mainland China, while the other side—technology and advanced manufacturing—relies heavily on U.S. and European markets. With U.S.–China competition heating up, companies face increased pressure to choose sides.

Wu Zhongshu believes that future corporate investment layout cannot focus only on tariffs; it must also incorporate international situations, industry trends, own niche, ESG, carbon border adjustment mechanisms, currency, and regulations into medium‑to‑long‑term planning. Overall, he remains optimistic about Taiwan’s prospects, noting that Taiwanese companies possess flexibility and resilience, but must move from solo play to strengthen strategic alliances and cross‑industry, cross‑country cooperation to maintain competitive advantage amid rapid global changes.
AI Reaches the Third Round: Capital Expenditure and Infrastructure Demand Still Have Momentum

Regarding the market’s high concern over whether AI investment is overheated, Senior Associate Manager Xie Wenxiong of Nomura’s domestic equity department pointed out that AI is still in its early development stage, and large cloud service providers (CSPs) remain financially robust. This year, their bond issuance exceeded 180 billion USD; even if financing costs rise to 6%–7%, they continue to increase investment, showing confidence in long‑term returns. In addition, emerging cloud operators, telecoms, and sovereign funds are expected to take over the layout, keeping AI investment momentum steady.

Xie Wenxiong described it as, like the CEO of AMD, Su Zifeng, saying that AI development is only in the third inning of a baseball game, and there is still a long way to go before maturity. Currently, the real constraint on AI expansion is not capital but data center construction, power supply, and chip capacity. Global AI infrastructure is expected to take 3–5 years to complete; once infrastructure is in place, growth focus will shift from large language models and AI agents to robots, autonomous vehicles, smart factories, and biotech medical applications.

He believes that, based on the experience of the internet industry, long‑term value often emerges at the application end. As capital expenditure continues to expand and real applications accelerate, the AI industry trend is about to fully unfold. Exiting too early due to short‑term bubble concerns may cause investors to miss subsequent growth opportunities.
Taiwan Holds Key AI Segments; "Mountain Guardians" Benefit from Expanding Footprint

Global AI investment continues to expand, also benefiting Taiwan’s supply chain. Xie Wenxiong noted that the four major U.S. cloud service providers continue to increase capital expenditure, driving significant growth in Taiwan’s export orders, and the electronics and automation industries are heating up. According to NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang’s AI "five‑layer cake" framework—power supply, chips, infrastructure, models, and applications—Taiwan controls nearly four of these key layers. With U.S. security concerns accelerating AI supply chain decoupling from China, U.S. tech firms increasingly rely on Taiwan’s complete hardware manufacturing capability, further highlighting Taiwan’s key position in the global AI infrastructure wave.

Xie Wenxiong said that large CSPs still have strong demand for computing chips. In addition to NVIDIA’s continuous launch of new‑generation GPUs, CPUs, and networking chips, tech giants such as Google, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, and OpenAI are actively developing their own ASICs, continuously driving demand for advanced processes.

As AI computing specifications upgrade, the beneficiary scope gradually expands from advanced processes to advanced packaging, IC design, ABF substrates, PCBs, CCL, optical communication, power supply, and testing, forming the "Mountain Guardians" that support Taiwan’s AI industry. Xie Wenxiong stated that as long as global AI capital expenditure and application continue to advance, Taiwan’s complete hardware manufacturing ecosystem and key technological advantages will sustain supply‑chain growth momentum and continue to share the business opportunities brought by global AI infrastructure and application expansion.
AI Fundamentals Support the Market; Domestic Capital Strengthens Taiwan Stock Resilience

AI industry profitability expansion also injects growth momentum into Taiwan stocks. Xie Wenxiong said that TSMC and the AI supply chain continue to drive export growth, remaining a key engine for Taiwan’s economy and the stock market. TSMC’s market value accounts for about 40% of Taiwan stocks; with capital expenditure expanding, future profitability momentum is expected to continue. Meanwhile, electronics stocks are projected to grow earnings by over 60% this year and still have the potential to maintain 30%–50% growth next year. With no major economic shock, Taiwan stocks’ fundamentals remain supportive.

It is worth noting that Taiwan stocks have no longer relied solely on foreign capital to drive growth. Although foreign investors sold nearly 800 billion NTD last year and adjusted about 1.4 trillion NTD in the first seven months of this year, Taiwan stocks still show resilience, largely due to the rapid growth of domestic capital. Xie Wenxiong analyzed that Taiwan’s ETF assets grew from about 1–2 trillion NTD in 2019 to 8–9 trillion NTD today, and with listed companies’ dividends, salary income, and systematic investment plans, domestic capital absorption has clearly improved, reducing dependence on foreign capital. With AI fundamentals continuing and domestic capital momentum strengthening, if foreign capital re‑enters, it could further add upward momentum to Taiwan stocks.

items.title: 騰輝電子-KY(6672)爆發！毛利衝上35.98%新高，高階CCL需求升溫，報價與稼動率齊揚
items.title_en: Tenghui Electronics-KY (6672) Explodes! Gross Margin Hits New High of 35.98%, High‑End CCL Demand Warms Up, Prices and Utilisation Rise Together
paras: 騰輝電子-KY(6672-TW)近期營運爆發，2026年8月單月營收8.06億元創歷史新高，年增133%，主要受惠三大動能：軍工航太PI材料需求爆發、AI伺服器外溢訂單湧入、以及產品漲價循環發酵。這些利多直接反映在財務表現上，2026年第二季毛利率達35.98%創歷史新高，營益率16.78%創近4年新高，呈現量價齊揚的強勁格局。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

軍工航太需求升溫，PI材料成為重要成長動能
在產品結構方面，高毛利PI 901材料成為近期市場關注焦點。該材料主要應用於軍工航太及半導體測試領域，毛利率約62%至65%，其中軍工航太應用占PI 901營收約70%至80%。
隨著全球國防與航太需求升溫，騰輝電子的國防航太主板訂單年增約8成，應用也從傳統產品進一步延伸至雷達偵測、直升機及防空系統等領域。公司並已切入洛克希德馬丁、波音、空中巴士及雷神等國際軍工體系，相關訂單成長有望持續推升高毛利產品占比。
此外，PI材料在半導體老化測試板的應用也開始放量，相關營收占比從2025年不到3%，提升至2026年第一季約6%。美國代理商布局亦逐步發酵，營收占比從2025年的3.3%提高至2026年第一季約10%。
從產品組合來看，2026年第二季特殊材料營收占比已達45.5%，其中軍工與散熱材料營收成長約70%至80%。由於PI材料毛利率明顯高於公司整體平均，產品比重提升也成為推動毛利率上升的重要因素。

AI高階產能排擠，帶動一般材料訂單外溢
除了軍工需求，AI伺服器產業的高階材料需求也正在改變整體CCL供應鏈結構。
目前主要CCL廠商將高階產能優先配置至AI伺服器相關應用，使一般材料與部分中低階高頻材料供應趨緊。在此情況下，騰輝電子憑藉約2至3週的交期優勢，持續承接市場外溢訂單，帶動整體產能利用率由約5成提升至7成。
對騰輝電子而言，這波需求不僅帶來出貨量增加，也提供產品價格調整的空間，形成營收與毛利率同步改善的效果。

漲價效應持續發酵，產品價格仍有上調空間
價格方面，公司自2025年11月起陸續進行產品調價，一般材料累計漲幅約20%至25%，後續目標進一步調漲至50%。
2026年4月起，散熱鋁基板價格再調漲約10%至15%，PI材料則調漲約10%；市場預期2026年下半年部分產品報價仍有機會再上調10%至15%。其中，光電板累計漲幅已超過50%，軍工材料漲幅則超過20%。
在漲價與出貨同步成長的情況下，第二季毛利率已較去年同期增加5.89個百分點。法人預估，騰輝電子2026年全年營收有望年增約63%，全年毛利率則進一步提升至36.4%。

8月營收突破8億元，成長動能持續加速
近期營收數據也反映公司接單動能正在加快。騰輝電子7月營收達6.65億元，月增16%、年增91%；8月進一步突破8億元至8.06億元，年增133%，創下單月歷史新高。
累計2026年前8月營收年增53.6%，若後續軍工、AI外溢訂單及漲價效應持續發酵，全年營運表現仍有進一步上修空間。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

原物料與新廠進度，仍是後續觀察重點
不過，騰輝電子後續成長仍有兩項因素值得留意。
首先是原物料成本。玻纖布價格自2025年4月以來累計漲幅已達約200%，雖然公司目前具備一定的成本轉嫁能力，但若原物料價格持續快速上漲，仍可能壓縮產品利潤空間。
其次是泰國新廠進度。受到當地缺工問題影響，新廠量產時程延後至2026年8至9月，初期對營收的貢獻預計仍相對有限。
整體而言，騰輝電子目前正處於需求成長、產能利用率提升與產品漲價同步發生的階段。軍工航太PI材料提供高毛利成長動能，AI供應鏈則帶來訂單外溢，而漲價則進一步放大營收與獲利彈性。後續能否延續目前的高成長，關鍵仍在於高毛利產品占比、漲價落地程度，以及原物料成本能否持續有效轉嫁。

paras_en: Tenghui Electronics-KY (6672‑TW) has recently seen an operational explosion, with August 2026 monthly revenue reaching NT$8.06 billion, a historic high, up 133% year‑over‑year, driven by three major tailwinds: a surge in demand for PI materials in military‑aerospace, a flood of spill‑over orders from AI servers, and a price‑increase cycle. These positives are directly reflected in the financials, with Q2 2026 gross margin hitting a record 35.98% and operating margin reaching 16.78%, the highest in nearly four years, showing a strong pattern of both volume and price gains.
(Source: You Analysis Industry Database)

Military‑aerospace demand is heating up, making PI material a key growth driver. In the product mix, the high‑margin PI 901 material has become a market focus. This material is mainly used in military‑aerospace and semiconductor test applications, with a gross margin of about 62%‑65%, and military‑aerospace accounts for roughly 70%‑80% of PI 901 revenue.

As global defence and aerospace demand rises, Tenghui’s defence‑aerospace main‑board orders have grown about 80% year‑over‑year, and applications have expanded from traditional products to radar detection, helicopters and air‑defence systems. The company has also entered the supply chains of Lockheed Martin, Boeing, Airbus and Raytheon, and the related order growth is expected to continue boosting the share of high‑margin products.

In addition, PI material usage in semiconductor ageing test boards is also scaling up, with its revenue share rising from less than 3% in 2025 to about 6% in Q1 2026. The U.S. agency channel is likewise maturing, with its share increasing from 3.3% in 2025 to roughly 10% in Q1 2026.

Looking at the product portfolio, special‑material revenue accounted for 45.5% of Q2 2026 sales, with defence and thermal‑management material revenue growing about 70%‑80%. Because PI material’s margin is far above the company’s overall average, the higher weight of this product line is a key factor driving the rise in gross margin.
AI high‑end capacity crowding out lower‑end demand is driving spill‑over orders for ordinary materials.

Currently the major CCL manufacturers prioritize high‑end capacity for AI‑server applications, tightening supply of ordinary and some mid‑low‑end high‑frequency materials. In this environment, Tenghui leverages a 2‑3‑week lead‑time advantage to continuously capture spill‑over orders, lifting overall capacity utilisation from about 50% to 70%.
For Tenghui, this wave of demand not only raises shipment volumes but also provides room to adjust product prices, resulting in simultaneous improvements in revenue and gross margin.

The price‑increase effect continues to ferment, and there is still room for further price hikes. Since November 2025 the company has been gradually raising product prices, with cumulative increases of about 20%‑25% for ordinary materials, and it aims to push prices up to 50%.

From April 2026, the price of aluminium‑based heat‑sink substrates was raised again by about 10%‑15%, and PI material prices were increased by roughly 10%; the market expects that some product prices in the second half of 2026 could be lifted another 10%‑15%. Among them, optoelectronic board prices have risen by more than 50% cumulatively, and military‑aerospace material prices have risen by over 20%.

With price hikes and shipments growing together, Q2 gross margin is up 5.89 percentage points compared with the same period last year. Analysts estimate that Tenghui’s full‑year 2026 revenue could grow about 63% year‑over‑year, and the annual gross margin could further rise to 36.4%.

August revenue broke the NT$8 billion mark, and growth momentum keeps accelerating. Recent revenue figures also show the order intake is speeding up. Tenghui posted NT$6.65 billion in July, up 16% month‑over‑month and 91% year‑over‑year; in August it further surged past NT$8 billion to NT$8.06 billion, up 133% year‑over‑year, a historic monthly high.

Cumulative revenue for the first eight months of 2026 is up 53.6% year‑over‑year. If the military‑aerospace, AI spill‑over orders and price‑increase effects continue to develop, there is still room to revise the full‑year outlook upward.
(Source: You Analysis Industry Database)
Raw material costs and the progress of the new plant in Thailand remain key points to watch.

First, raw‑material costs. Since April 2025, the price of glass‑fiber cloth has risen about 200% cumulatively. Although the company currently has some ability to pass on costs, a continued rapid rise in raw‑material prices could still compress product profit margins.

Second, the progress of the new plant in Thailand. Due to local labour shortages, mass‑production timing has been pushed back to August‑September 2026, and its early contribution to revenue is expected to remain relatively limited.

Overall, Tenghui is presently in a phase where demand growth, higher capacity utilisation and price hikes are occurring simultaneously. Military‑aerospace PI material provides a high‑margin growth engine, the AI supply chain brings spill‑over orders, and price hikes further amplify revenue and profit flexibility. Whether the company can sustain this high growth will depend on the share of high‑margin products, the extent of price‑increase implementation, and the ability to continue passing on raw‑material costs.

items.title: 聯友金屬(7610)亮燈漲停！鎢價飆漲＋營收暴增722%，新產能接棒助攻
paras: 聯友金屬-創(7610-TW)受惠國際鎢價大幅上漲，加上中國出口管制推動全球鎢供應鏈重組，公司2026年營運表現明顯成長。

2026 年7月營收9.71億元，月增29%、年增722%，連續10個月改寫單月新高
2026 年上半年累計營收29.29 億元，年增 462%
國際鎢價較2025年同期大漲666%，鎢酸鈉出貨價年增761%

屏南二廠已於 7 月投產、鈷粉通過國際大廠認證開始供貨，2026 年下半年營收有機會較上半年近乎翻倍，全年法人預估 EPS 挑戰 50 元以上。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

出口管制並縮減開採配額，帶動鎢價大漲
本波營運成長的核心因素之一，是國際鎢供應趨緊帶動價格快速上漲。
中國自2025年2月起對鎢實施出口管制並縮減開採配額，市場供應受到限制；另一方面，近期地緣政治因素也進一步加速國際鎢庫存消耗，使海外市場供應更加吃緊。
在供應緊縮的環境下，國際鎢價較2025年同期大漲約666%，聯友金屬鎢酸鈉出貨價格年增幅更達761%，成為推升營收的重要因素。
從財務表現來看，2025年第二季營收約3.5億元，2026年第二季已增加至19億元，年增約450%；毛利率則由21.49%大幅提升至67.73%，增加46.24個百分點。市場估算第二季EPS約16.32元，獲利表現明顯優於去年同期。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

屏南二廠投產，鎢材料產能持續擴充
除了價格因素，聯友金屬也持續擴大鎢材料產能。
屏南二廠已於2026年7月投產，鎢酸鈉年產能預計增加約20%至30%；屏南三廠則規劃於2027年第四季量產，主要生產氧化鎢，年產能約6,000噸。由於氧化鎢產品價格較鎢酸鈉高約兩成，未來產能開出後，有助於公司進一步提高產品附加價值。
此外，屏科廠預計於2027年第四季量產碳化鎢及金屬鎢粉，布局將從鎢資源回收進一步延伸至高階鎢材料。
公司整體金屬處理能力預計在新廠陸續完成後，由目前約3,000至4,000噸，提升至8,000至10,000噸，2028年整體產能可望較目前倍增，逐步建立從資源回收至高階材料的完整製程。

鈷粉取得國際認證，第二成長曲線逐步成形
除了鎢材料之外，聯友金屬近年也積極布局鈷材料。子公司聯友先進的循環再製鈷粉，目前已通過數家國際大廠認證並開始供貨。
原先市場預期鈷粉在2026年第二季進入較明顯的放量階段，不過受到全球鎢粉供應緊張，以及硬質合金廠商調整拉貨排程影響，實際放量時間可能延後至下半年。
若後續訂單逐步放量，法人預期鈷粉將成為鎢材料之外的另一項成長來源。公司規劃2027年鈷粉產量達500噸，2028年進一步接近1,000噸。

下半年營運仍受關注，鎢價與產能成為兩大變數
展望後續，市場目前關注焦點主要落在鎢價能否維持高檔，以及新產能對營收的實際貢獻。
隨著屏南二廠開始投產，加上後續氧化鎢、碳化鎢及金屬鎢粉產能陸續開出，公司下半年營收有機會較上半年進一步成長。
不過，高鎢價也同時帶來成本壓力。鎢價上漲將推升廢鎢等原料採購成本，因此公司未來能否持續將成本轉嫁至產品價格，將直接影響毛利率表現。2026年第一季鎢相關產品毛利率曾達73.88%，在原料價格同步上漲的情況下，後續維持高檔仍有一定挑戰。
另一方面，若2027年哈薩克、韓國等地新增鎢礦產能陸續開出，市場供需缺口可能縮小至5%以內，鎢價漲勢也可能逐步趨緩。
整體而言，聯友金屬目前同時受惠於鎢價上漲、產品價格提升與新產能開出，短期營收與獲利動能仍強；中長期則取決於新廠擴產進度、高階鎢材料占比，以及鈷粉產品能否順利放量。若鎢價維持高檔並搭配產能持續擴張，公司營運規模仍有進一步成長空間，但高原料成本與鎢價反轉風險也值得持續觀察。

items.title: 雙鴻(3324)大利多！Vera Rubin水冷板重返輝達推薦名單，2026年營收拚增70%
paras:
峰迴路轉，Vera Rubin水冷板重返名單，9月底認證成關鍵
雙鴻證實，公司Vera Rubin水冷板目前已重新列入輝達推薦名單，並加速進行驗證，目標在2026年9月底前完成認證，最快有機會在第四季開始小量出貨。
這項進展也代表先前市場對雙鴻是否能延續Vera Rubin水冷板供應的疑慮出現轉折。此前5月一度傳出產品未列入推薦名單，6月重新獲邀加入測試，如今水冷板再次回到推薦名單，後續認證結果將成為短期重要觀察指標。
目前雙鴻原本就持續供應Vera Rubin的分歧管(Manifold)，此次市場焦點主要集中在水冷板產品。

Vera Rubin液冷規格升級，供應鏈需求同步放大
輝達新一代Rubin平台單櫃整合144顆GPU，功耗最高達230kW，全面採用水冷架構，相關液冷供應鏈規模預計約為前一代Blackwell的2倍。
因此，Vera Rubin水冷板能否順利取得認證，不只是單一產品的訂單問題，也牽動雙鴻能否持續切入輝達下一代散熱平台。
不過，長期仍需留意輝達預計在2028年導入的Microchannel Lid技術。若未來冷卻架構進一步往晶片端靠近，散熱零組件的設計與供應鏈分工可能再次出現變化。

2026年營收拚增70%，ASIC成第二成長曲線
除了Vera Rubin之外，雙鴻目前另一項重要成長動能來自ASIC業務。公司9月1日表示，2026年全年營收年增70%以上的目標維持不變，且目前營運展望較股東會時更加樂觀。第三季營收預估季增15%至20%，第四季則可望成為全年營收高峰。
目前幾項關鍵數據包括：

水冷營收占比：2026年上半年已達55%，7月單月約60%，全年至少6成，2027年朝7至8成發展
ASIC業務：2026年底單月營收占比將達約四成，涵蓋AWS、Meta、Arm及Apple等客戶，部分專案集中於第四季至2027年第一季
GB300加單：企業級客戶與CSP回補現有平台產品，短單與急單同步增加

法人預期，若ASIC專案能按照時程進入量產，雙鴻2026年全年營收年增幅有機會超過70%，毛利率則維持在30%左右。

泰國擴產加速，液冷產能持續擴大
隨著AI伺服器液冷需求持續成長，雙鴻也同步擴大全球產能，其中泰國將成為未來幾年的重要生產基地。
目前水冷板月產能目標提高至40萬至45萬片，分歧管產能也已擴充至每月約4,000對。
資本支出方面，雙鴻2024年至2026年累計投入近100億元，2027年資本支出預計仍與2026年相當，約30多億元，預計2028年後才會逐步趨緩。

隱憂與風險
雖然AI液冷與ASIC需求持續升溫，但雙鴻後續仍有幾項變數值得觀察：
1｜Vera Rubin認證尚未完成目前重新列入輝達推薦名單，但最終認證仍在進行中，9月底能否如期通過，將直接影響第四季水冷板出貨進度。
2｜消費電子需求仍偏弱VGA與PC產品線稼動率下滑，已對2026年第二季毛利率造成一定影響，2027年消費電子市場需求仍存在不確定性。
3｜液冷競爭加劇隨著AI伺服器液冷市場快速擴大，供應商數量也逐步增加，例如Supermicro的B200水冷產品供應商增加，後續價格競爭壓力值得關注。
整體而言，雙鴻目前正處於AI伺服器液冷需求擴張、ASIC放量與海外產能擴充同步推進的階段。短期市場焦點將落在9月底Vera Rubin水冷板認證結果，以及第四季ASIC與液冷產品的實際出貨量；若新產品認證與量產進度順利，2026年至2027年的營收成長動能仍值得持續追蹤。
重點摘要：
．Vera Rubin水冷板重返輝達推薦名單，目標2026年9月底完成認證，最快第四季小量出貨
．2026年營收成長目標維持70%以上，第三季估季增15%至20%，第四季將是全年營收高峰
．水冷營收占比持續提高，2026年上半年已達55%，7月單月約60%，全年至少達6成
．ASIC成為第二成長引擎，預計2026年底單月營收占比達約4成
．泰國二期9月量產，規模為一期3倍，水冷板與分歧管產能持續擴充

items.title_en: Not Just AI Server Demand—jpp-KY (5284‑TW) Hits 42.1% Gross Margin, AI Cabinet Orders Visible Through Year‑End
paras: 2026年09月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI伺服器需求持續升溫，市場焦點多集中在晶片、散熱與電源，但隨機櫃體積、承重及散熱結構日益複雜，精密機構件也開始由標準加工品轉向高度客製化產品。
jpp-KY(5284-TW)8月營收3.62億元，年增率13.16%；第二季合併營收12.03億元，毛利率更進一步升至42.1%，營收與毛利率雙創歷史新高。
公司透過與泰國指標性電源管理業者合作，切入AI伺服器機櫃、電源機殼及備援電池模組(BBU)等高階機構件市場。泰國北欖府生產基地鄰近主要客戶，有助於縮短物流距離並提高供應彈性，成為公司承接AI基礎設施訂單的重要條件。
真正值得注意的是，獲利率創高發生在產能仍然滿載、新噴漆廠尚未全面貢獻的階段。這代表AI業務帶來的不只是出貨量增加，產品組合與稼動率提升已先推動獲利結構改變。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

毛利率突破42%，已不是傳統金屬加工模式
jpp-KY(5284-TW)過去以精密金屬加工為基礎，但目前商業模式已逐步從依照客戶圖面生產，延伸至早期共同設計、一站式製程整合及高度客製化服務。
公司鎖定AI、航太、高階醫療及食品檢測等利基市場，與毛利率通常低於20%的傳統金屬OEM模式形成差異。
隨供應內容由單一零組件擴大至大型機櫃、電源機殼、BBU機構件及液冷模組，單一專案價值與客戶轉換成本也可能同步提高。
第二季毛利率升至42.1%，反映公司製造重心轉向AI相關高附加價值產品後，成長已不再只表現在營收規模，也開始反映在獲利能力。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

產能增加33%，積壓訂單迎來出貨出口
面對AI伺服器機櫃訂單滿載，jpp-KY(5284-TW)目前的主要限制已由需求轉向產能。過去塗裝產能不足，使部分訂單難以及時轉化為出貨；隨第二座自動化噴烤漆廠於第三季正式投產，下半年單日產能預計提高至400櫃，增幅雙位數。
市場預估，2026年通訊業務營收可望年增約四成，成長動能主要來自美系CSP客戶的AI伺服器機櫃，以及電源機殼與BBU機構件需求。
公司同時引進800噸大型沖壓設備，預計2027年開出，使沖壓產能較2025年增加約30%，並規劃2.2萬坪新廠，鎖定高階大型機構件市場。
新產能開出後，積壓訂單能否順利轉化為營收，以及公司能否在出貨放大的同時維持高毛利率，將是判斷這波成長品質的關鍵。擴產初期的折舊、良率與人員配置，也可能使短期獲利率出現波動。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

航太子公司由包袱轉貢獻，第二成長曲線開始驗證
公司透過法國子公司整合銑削、車削、塗裝及鈑金組裝等製程，並具備多項航太製程認證，使營運模式從泰國據點的大量製造，進一步延伸至歐洲的共同研發與一站式服務。
不過，航太業務在2024年受到客改貨(P2F)專案進度停滯及呆帳影響，營運表現一度承壓。目前公司正加快整合已併購的歐洲子公司，逐步重建成長動能，但相關整合效益尚未完全顯現，仍是後續觀察重點。
公司現階段目標是推動歐洲航太子公司達成損益兩平，並將產品布局由商用飛機零組件，進一步延伸至整機結構件、軍工防衛及維修市場。若產能與製程整合順利，航太業務可能由過去的獲利壓力來源，轉為支撐整體營運穩定度的第二成長引擎。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

paras_en: On September 4, 2026 (Yuan Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) AI server demand continues to heat up, with market focus largely on chips, cooling, and power supplies, but the increasing complexity of random cabinets in terms of volume, load capacity, and cooling structure has pushed precision mechanical components from standard parts to highly customized products.

jpp‑KY (5284‑TW) reported August revenue of 362 million NTD, a year‑over‑year increase of 13.16%; its second‑quarter consolidated revenue was 1.203 billion NTD, with gross margin rising further to 42.1%, setting new historical highs for both revenue and margin.

The company has entered the high‑end mechanical component market for AI server cabinets, power supply cases, and backup battery modules (BBU) by partnering with a leading Thai power management firm. The Thai northern province production base is close to major customers, helping shorten logistics distance and improve supply flexibility, becoming a key condition for the company to take on AI infrastructure orders.

What is truly noteworthy is that the margin peak occurred while capacity was still fully loaded and the new spray‑painting plant had not yet fully contributed. This indicates that the AI business brings more than just increased shipment volume; product mix and utilization rate improvements have already driven a change in the profit structure.
(Data source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)

Breaking 42% gross margin is no longer a traditional metal processing model. jpp‑KY (5284‑TW) has historically been based on precision metal processing, but its current business model has gradually shifted from producing according to customer drawings to early joint design, one‑stop process integration, and highly customized services.
The company targets niche markets such as AI, aerospace, high‑end medical, and food testing, differentiating itself from the traditional metal OEM model that typically has gross margins below 20%.

With the supply content expanding from single components to large cabinets, power supply cases, BBU mechanical parts, and liquid‑cooling modules, the value of a single project and customer conversion costs may also rise in tandem.

The second‑quarter gross margin rose to 42.1%, reflecting that after shifting manufacturing focus to high‑value AI products, growth is no longer only reflected in revenue scale but also in profitability.
(Data source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)

Capacity increased by 33%, backlog orders are now ready for shipment. Facing full AI server cabinet orders, jpp‑KY (5284‑TW)’s main limitation has shifted from demand to capacity. Past coating capacity shortages made it difficult to convert some orders into shipments; with the second automated spray‑painting plant coming online in Q3, daily capacity is expected to rise to 400 cabinets in the second half of the year, a double‑digit increase.

The market estimates that 2026 communication business revenue could grow by about 40% annually, with growth momentum mainly coming from US CSP customers’ AI server cabinets, as well as demand for power supply cases and BBU mechanical parts.

The company has also introduced an 800‑ton large stamping machine, expected to be operational in 2027, increasing stamping capacity by about 30% from 2025, and plans a 22,000‑pyeong new plant to target the high‑end large mechanical component market.

After new capacity comes online, whether backlog orders can smoothly convert into revenue and whether the company can maintain high gross margins while expanding shipments will be key to judging the quality of this growth wave. Depreciation, yield, and personnel allocation in the early expansion phase may also cause short‑term margin fluctuations.
(Data source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)

The aerospace subsidiary has shifted from a burden to a contributor, and the second growth curve is now being validated. The company integrates milling, turning, painting, and sheet metal assembly processes through its French subsidiary, which holds multiple aerospace process certifications, extending its operating model from large‑scale manufacturing in Thailand to joint R&D and one‑stop services in Europe.

However, the aerospace business faced operational pressure in 2024 due to a stalled P2F project and bad debt, temporarily impacting performance. The company is accelerating integration of its acquired European subsidiary, gradually rebuilding growth momentum, but the integration benefits have not yet fully materialized and remain a focus for future observation.

The company’s current goal is to bring the European aerospace subsidiary to break even and shift product focus from commercial aircraft components to full aircraft structures, military defense, and maintenance markets. If capacity and process integration go smoothly, the aerospace business could shift from a past profit pressure source to a second growth engine supporting overall operational stability.
(Data source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)

items.title: 金融指數衝3522點續創高 富邦金站上150元、市值2.1兆元締新猷
items.title_en: Financial Index Climbs to 3,522 Points, Sets New High; Fubon Financial Surpasses NT$150, Market Cap Exceeds NT$2.1 Trillion
paras: 台股高檔震盪之際，金融族群持續扮演撐盤與攻堅的核心要角。上市金融指數今(4)日強勢上揚1.17%，收盤衝上3,522.36點，再度刷新歷史新高紀錄，「金控雙雄」強勢走高，富邦金(2881-TW)更是首度站上150元大關，刷新歷史新高，市值突破 2.1 兆元，在升息預期升溫下，整體金融股紅光滿面。
金控獲利王富邦金今日交易相當活絡，終場勁揚2.38%，股價衝上150.5元，不僅再度刷寫歷史新高，在股本達1560.74億元的龐大體量下，單日市值猛增約490.25億元，攀升至2兆1081.08億元，突破2.1兆元大關，穩居台股市值第七大。
同為龍頭的國泰金(2882-TW)表現亦不遑多讓，今日終場上漲2.22%，收在115元，股價強勢逼近前波高點。國泰金目前股本為1620.25億元，今日市值增加367億元、來到1兆6869.59億元，居台股第十名。
在雙雄帶頭衝鋒下，中大型金融股同步走強，包括中信金、元大金、華南金、第一金等今日普遍繳出1%至2%的漲幅；玉山金、永豐金及台新新光金等金控股亦在盤上游走，獲得買盤力挺。
法人分析，從總體經濟環境觀察，美國聯準會(Fed)利率政策預期反覆，使市場重新定價高利率環境停留的時間。利率維持高檔甚至潛在升息的預期，直接點火銀行業淨利差(NIM)擴大的獲利想像空間。
與此同時，中東戰雲密布促使市場避險情緒升溫，大盤面臨獲利了結與去槓桿壓力，具備穩健殖利率與政策護盤色彩的金融族群，自然成為內外資「棄高就低」的最佳避風港。
展望金融股後市，法人認為，以銀行為核心業務的金控股將最直接受惠於利差維持高檔與放款動能；而在大盤波動加劇之際，兼具資產品質良好與高配息潛力的公股金控與大型金控，將持續扮演資金避險與法人加碼布局的重心，後續防禦及續航力道仍值得正面期待。

paras_en: During the high‑level volatility of the Taiwan stock market, the financial sector continues to play a core role in supporting and defending the market. The listed financial index surged 1.17% today (April 4), closing at 3,522.36 points and setting a new historical record. The two dominant financial holding companies rose strongly, with Fubon Financial (2881‑TW) reaching the NT$150 mark for the first time, breaking a new high and pushing its market capitalization past NT$2.1 trillion amid rising expectations of interest‑rate hikes.

Fubon Financial, the profit king of the financial holding sector, saw very active trading today, ending up 2.38% higher and closing at NT$150.5. The stock not only set a new historical high again but also saw its market cap jump roughly NT$49.025 billion in a single day, reaching NT$2.08108 trillion and surpassing the NT$2.1 trillion threshold, securing its position as the seventh‑largest company by market cap in Taiwan.

Cathay Financial (2882‑TW), another industry leader, also performed strongly, closing up 2.22% at NT$115 and approaching the previous high. With a share capital of NT$162.025 billion, its market cap increased by NT$36.7 billion to NT$1.686959 trillion, ranking tenth in Taiwan.

Under the leadership of the two giants, mid‑to‑large‑cap financial stocks also strengthened, with Zhongxin, Yuanta, Hua Nan, First, and others posting gains of 1% to 2% today. Yushan, Yongfeng, and Taishin New Light Financial Holdings also moved up in the market, supported by buying pressure.

From an institutional perspective, the overall economic environment shows that repeated expectations of the U.S. Federal Reserve’s rate policy are causing the market to reprice the duration of a high‑rate environment. The expectation of sustained high rates or potential rate hikes directly fuels the profit potential of banks’ net interest margin expansion.

Meanwhile, the cloud of Middle Eastern conflict has heightened risk‑aversion sentiment, putting the market under profit‑taking and deleveraging pressure. Financial stocks, with their solid dividend yields and policy support, naturally become the best safe haven for both domestic and foreign investors looking to “sell high, buy low.”

Looking ahead, institutions believe that financial holding companies centered on banking will benefit most directly from high interest‑rate spreads and loan momentum. In a market with heightened volatility, publicly listed financial holdings with good asset quality and high dividend potential will continue to serve as key defensive and growth targets for institutional investors, and their subsequent defensive and sustainable momentum is worth positive expectations.

items.title: 賴清德：落實亞洲資產管理中心計畫 台灣金融下階段將深化資產管理路線
items.title_en: Lai Ching-te: Implementing the Asian Asset Management Center Plan, Taiwan’s Finance Sector to Deepen Asset Management in the Next Phase
paras: 總統賴清德今(4)日出席「金融發展與前瞻研討會」時表示，台灣有豐沛的民間資金及世界級的產業實力，政府會全力落實亞洲資產管理中心計畫，並持續推動法規函令的調適與鬆綁，讓台灣金融市場走向國際，成為連結產業與全資本的重要平台，相信未來在產官學界共同努力下，一定能將台灣的產業優勢轉化為金融實力與國家競爭力，在全球經濟發展中扮演更重要的角色。
賴清德指出，在政府持續精進金融政策及產業界共同打拚之下，前(2024)年台灣經濟成長率為5.6%、去(2025)年達8.76%，也帶動銀行、證券期貨及保險等金融三業，創下史上獲利最高與次高紀錄，三業獲利更首度突破兆元大關。今年經濟成長率預估可達11.05%，金融三業獲利也會比去年、前年更高。
賴清德強調，目前政府正努力落實亞洲資產管理中心計畫，過去2年政府持續推動法規函令的調適與鬆綁，讓金融機構有更大空間開展資產管理業務，提供更多元、更具國際競爭力的商品與服務，截至今(2026)年6月，金融業的資產管理規模已達到46兆元，相較於計畫推動前更增加約14兆元。
賴清德表示，目前金融以持續引導資金投入中小微企業、五大信賴產業、公共建設及能源轉型，這些成果皆顯示，台灣已具備發展國際資產管理的扎實基礎。下一階段，台灣金融要走的路就是深化資產管理、壯大資本市場、擴大跨境服務，資產管理可匯聚資金，資本市場則將資金導向企業，兩者相互支撐，將形成「資金支持創新、企業成長又吸引更多資金」的正向循環。

賴清德也提及，金管會主委彭金隆推動亞洲資產管理中心時，曾訂下「二年有感、四年有變、六年有成」的階段目標，如今「二年有感」已交出初步成果，正式進入「四年有變」階段。接下來，政府將根據高雄資產管理專區的試辦經驗，為跨境金融、家族辦公室及創新金融商品等服務建立更完整的規範，並將成熟可行的項目逐步推廣至全國，未來台灣資產管理將橫跨銀行、證券、保險及跨境服務，現行分業管理各有不同規範，為建立更完整的法制基礎，金管會目前也正研擬制定「金融市場與資產管理發展條例」專法。
賴清德也希望透過立法，將試辦經驗轉化為長期、穩且可預期的制度，並在兼顧風險管理與投資人保護的前提下，讓金融業者可以長期布局，也讓國際市場看見台灣持續推動金融市場與資產管理發展的決心。
paras_en: President Lai Ching-te attended the "Financial Development and Forward-looking Seminar" today (April 4) and said that Taiwan has abundant private capital and world-class industrial strength. The government will fully implement the Asian Asset Management Center plan and continue to adjust and loosen regulatory directives, enabling Taiwan’s financial market to go international and become an important platform linking industry and capital. He believes that with joint efforts from industry, government, academia, and the community, Taiwan’s industrial advantages can be transformed into financial strength and national competitiveness, playing a more important role in global economic development.

Lai Ching-te pointed out that under continued refinement of financial policies and joint efforts with industry, Taiwan’s economic growth rate was 5.6% in 2023 and reached 8.76% in 2024, driving the banking, securities, futures, and insurance sectors to record the highest and second-highest profits ever. The three sectors’ profits also broke the trillion-yuan threshold for the first time. This year’s economic growth rate is estimated to reach 11.05%, and the profits of the three sectors will be higher than last year and the year before.

Lai Ching-te emphasized that the government is currently working to implement the Asian Asset Management Center plan. Over the past two years, the government has continued to adjust and loosen regulatory directives, giving financial institutions greater space to develop asset management businesses and provide more diverse and internationally competitive products and services. As of June 2026, the scale of asset management in the financial industry has reached 46 trillion yuan, an increase of about 14 trillion yuan compared to before the plan was promoted.

Lai Ching-te said that the current financial sector continues to guide capital into small and micro enterprises, the five major trusted industries, public construction, and energy transition. These achievements demonstrate that Taiwan has a solid foundation for developing international asset management. The next phase for Taiwan’s finance is to deepen asset management, strengthen the capital market, and expand cross-border services. Asset management can pool funds, while the capital market directs funds to enterprises; the two support each other, creating a positive cycle of "funds supporting innovation, enterprise growth, and attracting more capital."

Lai Ching-te also mentioned that when the Financial Supervisory Commission Chairman Peng Jin-long promoted the Asian Asset Management Center, he set a phased goal of "feel the impact in two years, change in four years, and achieve results in six years." The "feel the impact in two years" has already delivered preliminary results, officially entering the "change in four years" stage. Next, the government will use the trial experience of the Kaohsiung Asset Management Special Zone to establish more complete regulations for cross-border finance, family offices, and innovative financial products, and gradually promote mature and feasible projects nationwide. In the future, Taiwan’s asset management will span banks, securities, insurance, and cross-border services. The current sectoral management has different regulations, so the FSC is also drafting a special law, the "Financial Market and Asset Management Development Act," to build a more complete legal foundation.

Lai Ching-te also hopes to use legislation to transform the trial experience into a long-term, stable, and predictable system, while balancing risk management and investor protection. This will allow financial institutions to plan long-term and let the international market see Taiwan’s determination to continuously promote the development of the financial market and asset management.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉震盪走高漲693點收46551點 重返5日線周漲219點連二紅
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks After Hours: Oscillating Higher, Up 693 Points to 46,551, Back to 5‑Day Line, Weekly Rise 219 Points, Two Consecutive Green Candles
paras: 美國聯準會(FED)升息預期降、美債殖利率下滑，台股今(4)日早盤震盪後一路走高，金電族群同步發力，收盤漲693.47點來到46551.13點，再度站回4萬6及5日線，成交值再收斂至8256億元；單周則漲219.68點、周K連二紅。
觀察權值股表現，台積電(2330-TW)上漲20元或0.84%，收2410元，聯發科(2454-TW)上漲1.7%、台達電(2308-TW)及漲逾3%，電子代工族群走強，鴻海(2317-TW)、廣達(2382-TW)漲3%，仁寶(2324-TW)漲7%、和碩(4938-TW)、緯創也漲5%；華碩(2357-TW)及研華(2395-TW)也漲逾5%。

items.title: 【優分析即時新聞】聯電(2303)資本支出上修33%！AI擴產訊號點火，股價爆量漲4%
paras: 2026年09月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 聯電(2303-TW)今（4）日盤中爆量上漲4%，報130元，成交量超過11.7萬張。市場焦點落在公司將2026年資本支出由15億美元上修至20億美元，增幅達33%，反映聯電對AI、矽光子及先進封裝需求的信心升高。
(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)
聯電同時通過近50億美元的投資計畫，預計未來兩至三年分階段投入。擴產將由新加坡與台南雙軌進行，新加坡P4廠鎖定矽光子與先進技術，台南新廠則支援先進封裝及客戶長期需求；公司8月再宣布發行最高18億美元海外可轉債，用於設備及廠務工程。
聯電擴產並非只押注傳統成熟製程。公司已攜手SILITH完成首批1.6T矽光子晶圓量產，AI相關業務2026年營收預估接近3億美元，未來三年有望突破10億美元；與英特爾合作的12奈米製程也預計2027年量產。

(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)
整體而言，聯電上修資本支出，代表公司投資策略已由保守轉向擴張，也成為今日股價走強的重要支撐。不過，大規模擴產將增加未來折舊費用，可轉債亦存在股本稀釋風險，後續仍須觀察新增產能能否順利轉化為營收。
